rule: Apply only when a reliable external event maps to one category; never infer a detailed task from generic busy state.

modifiers.name: Retry Grip
modifiers.accessory: the same two work tiles as Tile Feed
modifiers.action: A tile slips out of the claws and drops away; the claws grab for the next one and start over.
modifiers.designNote: 刻意**复用 Tile Feed 的道具与场景**，只改材料的命运：牌升到一半滑脱掉下去，爪子扑空，身体一顿，再抓下一块。用户不需要学新符号——同样的画面里「这次没接住」本身就是失败的意思。与 working 的对比是这个动作全部的表意来源，所以时长也刻意取一样的 3.4s。

modifiers.name: Deep Work
signalExamples: 同一个 working 状态持续超过 3 分钟
modifiers.accessory: the work tiles plus a slowly growing stack of finished ones
modifiers.action: Smaller, steadier motion with half-lidded eyes; finished tiles pile up at the side.
modifiers.designNote: 「干很久」不能画成「更快」——那读作着急。反过来：幅度更小、节奏更沉、眼睛半阖，像进了心流。身侧那摞完成品缓慢增高，是唯一说明「已经干了不少」的可见证据。时长 5.0s 比 working 的 3.4s 更慢，也是同一个意思。
